# KCRA Channel 3

> > KCRA Channel 3 is Northern California's leading news station covering Sacramento, Stockton, and Modesto with breaking news, weather, crime reporting, and local community stories.

KCRA serves the Central Valley region with comprehensive coverage of local news, weather forecasts, and community events. The station features reporters like Jonathan Ayestas and Daniel Macht covering stories from crime and breaking news to education and lifestyle features across Northern California.

## Key Topics

- Sacramento news and weather
- Stockton and Modesto coverage
- Northern California breaking news
- Crime reporting and public safety
- Central Valley communities
- Local weather forecasts
- Education and schools
- Community stories
- California state news
- Local investigations
- Traffic and transportation
- Regional events

## News & Weather

- [KCRA Channel 3 Home](http://www.kcra.com/): Main homepage for Sacramento, Stockton, and Modesto news, weather forecasts, and breaking news coverage across Northern California

## Education & Community

- [Creative teachers help students do well on STAR testing](https://www.kcra.com/article/creative-teachers-help-students-do-well-on-star-testing/5786303): Valley High School teachers use creative teaching methods, dressing as historical figures to help students prepare for STAR standardized tests

## Lifestyle & Features

- [Gift Wrap Paper Cutter](https://www.kcra.com/article/gift-wrap-paper-cutter/5595822): Local inventor creates innovative gift wrapping tool designed to simplify paper cutting for holiday gift preparation
- [Butterball offers turkey-cooking advice](https://www.kcra.com/article/butterball-offers-turkey-cooking-advice/5521574): Butterball expert Phyllis Kramer provides Thanksgiving turkey cooking tips and advice for holiday meal preparation
